event.description:
Entry Fee: $25 plus tax.

Register Here: https://magicstronghold.com/store/category/Grand%20Archive%20Events

Format: Draft (.asphodel/paradise)

Structure:
 - Up to 3 Swiss rounds
 - Best of 1
 - 40 minute rounds

Prizing:
Each player receives 2 Event Packs with entry. 2 .asphodel/paradise booster packs will be entered in the prize pool for each player. Packs will be distributed between all records 2-1 or better.
event.name: MSG .asphodel/paradise Draft Day Dec 6th
